desc:
Fly 21 fighter jets and 7 helicopters in fast air combat! Dogfight real players and AI, sink carriers, bomb bases and win the match for your team.

✈️ 21 JETS: F-5E, A-4 Skyhawk & MiG-21 free, up to the F-22, Su-57, F-35, F-14 Tomcat, MiG-25 & A-10
🚁 7 HELICOPTERS: Little Bird, Huey & Medevac free, plus Cobra, Hind, Apache & Ka-52
🎮 4 MODES: Strike base assault, Dogfight, Free-for-All & Naval carrier battles
🚀 Heat-seekers, radar & anti-ship missiles, bombs, rockets & guns
🎨 Paint schemes and upgrades for every aircraft
🔥 Kill streaks, medals, bomber raids & convoys mid-match
🌙 Day & night, carrier launches, ejection seats
🎓 Flight school, easy mouse aim & phone controls
🏆 Leaderboards, daily rewards & missions

CONTROLS: Mouse fly | Click guns | Space weapons | R next weapon | Shift/Ctrl throttle | X flares | M map | Tab scores

NEW: 12 jets, paint schemes, upgrades, the Shop, VIP & Auto Rearm
